tools.name: web_fetch
tools.description: Fetch a URL over HTTP and return what the server sent, as text. No browser and no scripts, so it is fast and cheap — the right first choice for an API or JSON endpoint, a raw file, a feed, a README, documentation, or any page whose text is in the HTML the server sends. A non-HTML body comes back verbatim. If the page turns out to be assembled by its scripts, the result says so and names web_browse; call that on the same URL.
